decisions.reason: As a multi-model line that had its own page and sits close to the firm's dental materials business, management is likely to continue backing it and explain any weaker traction as temporary rather than reverse course quickly.
This thermoforming blank fits the firm's core laboratory workflow offering and earlier public launch effort, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

Because the lacquer appears less prominently and is less central to the firm's digital-growth narrative, it faces a higher stop risk, but prior investment and product-range completeness still favor keeping it for now.

The hearing-protection earmold line uses the firm's custom-manufacturing capabilities and serves an existing customer segment, so management would likely persist with it unless results became clearly untenable.
